patthana15.32:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no āsavo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ
patthana15.32:2.1: āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.32:3.1: no āsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na no āsavo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
